newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill re-evaluates HSBC.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill re-evaluates HSBC.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has reinstated coverage of HSBC Holdings Plc with a recommendation of accumulate, the company said in a research report.
Merrill Lynch analyst Keith Irving said the recent outperformance of the share was only an indication of its true worth.
"We believe HSBC's share price is beginning to reflect the group's true worth. The degree of undervaluation has reduced but we believe remains severe," the November 15 report said.
Irving said the share at HK$162 was trading at a 20 percent discount to the market.
The Hong Kong component of HSBC alone could be argued to be worth more than 85 percent of the group's market capitalisation, Irving said.
